timeline.summary: India Ratings upgraded Olectra Greentech's ₹1,532 Cr bank loan facilities to IND A/Stable and IND A1.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹644.72 Cr (+43.6% YoY), net profit ₹57.39 Cr (+177.4% YoY).
Olectra Greentech’s Board, led by Vice President P. Hanuman Prasad, recommended a final dividend of ₹0.60 per share (15% of ₹4 face value) on May 29, 2026, pending shareholder approval.
Olectra Greentech Limited shared the audio recording link for its June 1, 2026 conference call on FY2026 audited results via Vice President & Company Secretary Hanuman Prasad Hanuma.
Olectra Greentech filed the transcript of the investor conference call held on June 1, 2026.

watchlist.text: Shareholder approval for final dividend at AGM
